copy.text: These buttons move the inspection, not the notes. Together means both rhythms have a note in the same slot.
Count from one played note to the next, including the wrap into the next measure. A single note leaves twelve slots between appearances.
Left to right is one measure. The top row is three; the bottom row is four. Outlines are notes left out. The line is the slot being inspected.
The clock still shows both rhythms. Choose one to hear its spaces before putting the two together.
Trade the pitches, not the note slots. Missing notes stay silent; neither voice grows louder.
Unchecked notes leave a silence. Moving four shifts all its notes together; three stays put.
Reflect the four-note rhythm around slot one. Missing notes move too; three stays fixed. Undo restores the old positions.
The kept pattern does not change when you edit. Return changes the pattern, not the tempo; Undo brings your experiment back.
Two measures at the current rate, with 0.20 seconds of silence between. The inspection stays still. Stop ends the comparison; neither pattern is replaced.

cases.title: Three against four — Choose which rhythm an edit changes before opening its tools
cases.goal: Manual note choices remain immediate. Optional transformations say whether they change Three, Four or both, instead of appearing as one undifferentiated row.
cases.steps: Inside #rhythm-editor add three closed sibling details #rhythm-three-tools, #rhythm-four-tools and #rhythm-both-tools after the existing direct note checkboxes/offset and #rhythm-edit-help. Three gets rhythm-invert-a, rhythm-roll-a-forward/back and rhythm-roll-a-help. Four gets rhythm-invert-b, rhythm-reflect-four and rhythm-reflect-four-help. Both gets rhythm-keep-meetings and rhythm-keep-meetings-help. Split old inversion wrappers rather than moving both into one door. Keep every native note checkbox, #rhythm-offset, its label, shared edit help, Undo and Reset directly outside these doors in the editor. No candidate/model/transport changes. Existing outer #rhythm-editor remains closed as before.
cases.message: Three Four and shared transformations use independent doors while direct note choices stay outside

cases.title: Three against four — Keep the saved rhythm after the current measure
cases.goal: The measure and its direct playback lead. A saved rhythm and the two-pattern audition remain optional and retain the sound-off default and visible volume caution.
cases.steps: Wrap intact section.kept-section in closed details #rhythm-memory-drawer at its existing position after the editor section. Keep every saved pattern reader/control/help and #rhythm-compare-play inside it. Keep #rhythm-volume-caution, #rhythm-sound, all ordinary playback/rate/count/voice choices and current rhythm readers outside memory. Preserve the kept body's own hidden attribute and all audio/eligibility logic. No JS/model change. Do not rewrite701's title or caution.
cases.message: a saved rhythm waits behind the current measure without hiding sound safety or ordinary playback
